scope: Frontier-12 automatic-display proposal execution; current normal provider remains unchanged

runtimeEvidence.interpretation: Both stages exceed a safe single synchronous main-thread assumption on difficult/dense controls; measurements exclude process startup but remain diagnostic rather than browser SLA.

executionDecision.strength: source-backed architecture decision; implementation not performed
executionDecision.frontierPlacement: same Worker as Product proposal evaluation, after serializable snapshot/input transfer
executionDecision.productPlacement: pure current-source presentation evaluation/ranking/final selection may run in that Worker; main thread retains snapshot validation, adoption decision, viewport/render, and session/Dataset mutation authority
executionDecision.mainThreadSynchronous: retain only for current settleInitialPlacement fallback and small internal controls; not the Frontier automatic-display execution path
executionDecision.cooperativeMainThread: not selected as the primary path because the shared Frontier generator is currently monolithic and has no natural resumable yield boundary; it would require a separate resumable refactor
executionDecision.workerIsolation: recommended to protect browser responsiveness and support responsive termination for the combined pure proposal computation
executionDecision.sameWorkerMeaning: yes for computation and transport efficiency; this does not move Product authority into Frontier or make Worker output self-adopting

workerBoundary.serializableInput: Dataset/graph identity and revision, coordinate authority, session positions, manual route/label/Self-loop snapshots, locale, algorithm version, and explicit budget/config
workerBoundary.serializableOutput: complete finite candidate/proposal and, if evaluated in Worker, complete Product presentation/metrics snapshot plus operation envelope
workerBoundary.nonTransferableCurrentAppState: App refs, React state setters, diagnostic callback sinks, DOM/SVG elements, and live viewport objects stay main-thread adapters; diagnostics are not required for the production message
workerBoundary.verification: main thread checks operationId/generation, semantic snapshot identity, complete finite positions/presentation, and current coordinate authority before publishing

lifecycleContract.operationIdentity: monotonic operationId plus generation token and immutable semantic snapshot identity
lifecycleContract.datasetReplacement: invalidate the active operation before staging/replacing the Dataset; never accept a result from the replaced identity
lifecycleContract.repeatedOpen: each open gets a new operation identity; prior work is cancelled/invalidated and cannot displace the newer operation
lifecycleContract.unmountRemount: unmount requests cancellation and removes delivery authority; remount starts from a new snapshot/operation
lifecycleContract.staleResultRejection: reject messages whose operationId, generation, Dataset/graph/revision, coordinate authority, manual presentation fingerprints, locale, or algorithm/budget identity differs
lifecycleContract.completionCancelRace: cancellation wins when observed before delivery/commit; Worker termination is best effort and token validation remains authoritative
lifecycleContract.technicalFailure: discard partial output, record failure, and use the existing bounded settleInitialPlacement fallback for coordinate-less initial display
lifecycleContract.fallbackThenLateResult: fallback does not reopen the old operation; late output is stale and discarded
lifecycleContract.storedCoordinates: do not run Frontier; stored/authored coordinates remain authoritative
lifecycleContract.mixedCoordinates: retain existing mixed-completion authority; do not replace explicit positions with a Frontier proposal
lifecycleContract.publication: no partial candidate, intermediate presentation, or failed result is published or persisted

cancel.responsive: not possible for current synchronous generator on the main thread; Worker termination provides the appropriate interruption primitive for the recommended path
cancel.workerTerminate: useful for resource release but insufficient without lifecycle identity checks
cancel.cooperativeCancellation: not required for the selected primary path; remains an alternative only if a future non-Worker fallback is intentionally supported

transientPreview.naturalBoundary: completed candidate set plus completed Product-selected presentation as an operation-local snapshot
transientPreview.intermediateGeometry: not a safe natural publication point; the generator does not expose a semantically complete intermediate candidate
transientPreview.cost: do not rerun high-cost Product presentation merely to animate progress
transientPreview.contract: preview remains disposable and isolated from current session/Dataset until a separate explicit acceptance design

appResponsibility: main-thread validation and render-only derived-position adoption

proofEvidence.status: diagnostic actual Worker execution, parity, dense responsiveness, and cancellation established

remainingBlockers: promote the DEV-staged App async adapter through a separate production-integration checkpoint
nextCheckpoint: evaluate production integration of the DEV-staged App async adapter; keep the normal provider/default unchanged until explicit adoption
